evidence.reason: render_units selects templates by basename and writes each to output / source.name without checking duplicate basenames. If the target tree contains both crq-repair.service and extra/crq-repair.service, both pass the crq- filter and render to the same output path; the later write silently overwrites the earlier and paths records the same target twice.
